lines: NRJN Family Trust, represented by Entrust Family Office Legal & Trusteeship Services Private Limited, sells up to 1,050,000 shares in the offer.
Proceeds of up to ₹141.96 crore have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), so the trigger is old.
Gain of up to ₹132.00 crore before offer expenses and taxes makes this a meaningful liquidity event worth a call.
Pre-offer holding is unknown and not verified, and confidence is medium; confirm holding before engaging.
